description:
Where LLMxRay runs and what it holds: the observe port and whether it listens, the Ollama it forwards to and its version, how many turns are kept of the 500 it holds, whether request text is kept on disk, and when it started.
Use it first when diagnose_my_turns or read_my_last_turn answers that nothing was seen, or to confirm which Ollama your calls reach. Those tools read the turns; this one reads the server itself.
Takes no arguments. Nothing can be changed through MCP; settings live on the Live page. Needs LLMxRay running (npx llmxray); if it is not reachable the answer says so and names the URL tried. Under a second.
name: read_llmxray_status
title: Read LLMxRay status
